executive_summary.description: 150-250 words: the ranked strategies in one line each, the central numeric targets, the biggest uncertainties, and the scope decision on pharmacotherapy.

top_10_strategies.description: Exactly 10 distinct strategies, ordered by rank 1-10, each rank used once.

rank.description: 1 = most effective. Each rank exactly once.

strategy_name.description: Specific, actionable name of one distinct lever.

evidence_grade.description: GRADE-like certainty as defined in the input; use the weaker of the WLM and muscle-preservation claims that justify the rank.

ranking_rationale.description: Scores 0-5 for C1 long-term fat loss/WLM, C2 lean-mass preservation, C3 certainty, C4 feasibility/safety, the weighted total, and one sentence on why this rank.

effect_size_summary.description: 2-4 key studies or meta-analyses: design, k and/or N, population, duration, dropout, effect in natural units with 95% CI; then CONFIRMS/MODIFIES/OVERTURNS for the newest evidence.

long_term_weight_loss_mechanism.description: Why it works for long-term fat loss and maintenance (adherence, satiety, NEAT compensation, adaptive thermogenesis, habit formation); demonstrated vs hypothesized.

muscle_preservation_mechanism.description: How it protects skeletal muscle (MPS/MPB balance, mechanical tension, anabolic signaling, energy availability); state explicitly if no muscle-preserving effect is shown.

target_population.description: Who the numbers apply to (e.g., adults with obesity, lean resistance-trained, older adults) and how they differ by population.

primary_target_metric.description: The single most important quantitative target, e.g. 'protein intake' or 'resistance-training volume'.

primary_target_low.description: Lower bound of the primary target; equal to high for a single threshold; null only if no defensible number exists.

primary_target_high.description: Upper bound of the primary target; null only if no defensible number exists.

primary_target_unit.description: Unit of the primary target, e.g. 'g/kg FFM/day', '% body weight/week', 'hard sets/muscle/week', 'h/night'.

minimum_effective_dose.description: Lowest dose with demonstrated benefit, with numbers and units.

dose_and_frequency.description: Full numeric protocol: amounts, per-meal or per-session doses, sessions or days per week, intensity, timing.

progression_and_adjustment_rules.description: Numeric decision rules, e.g. how to adjust intake if weekly loss falls outside the target range for 2-3 weeks.

monitoring_and_success_criteria.description: What to measure, how often, and the target values or thresholds that define success or trigger action.

duration_and_maintenance_transition.description: How long to apply it during the deficit and how it changes in the maintenance phase (12-24 months after loss).

counter_evidence.description: Strongest null or contrary findings and main objections, with citations.

physiological_targets_summary.description: Numeric ranges for the active fat-loss phase, consistent with the strategy protocols.

notes.description: Population, kcal/day equivalent, evidence vs expert consensus.
Range for optimal lean-mass retention; how it differs for lean trained vs obesity.
Population and whether reference or adjusted body weight should be used in obesity.
Origin of the range (e.g., lean trained athletes) and strength of evidence.

minimum_fat_g_per_kg_bw.description: Minimum daily dietary fat in g/kg body weight; caveats go into general_notes.

resistance_training_minimum_dose.description: Hard sets per muscle group per week, sessions per week, load or RM range, proximity to failure (RIR).

maintenance_phase_targets.description: Numeric targets for the first 12-24 months after loss: physical activity (min/week or steps/day), self-weighing frequency, regain threshold for action, energy-intake recalibration.

general_notes.description: Population differences, evidence strength of the fat minimum and other thresholds, safety caveats.

synergy_matrix.description: 6-12 interactions showing how behavioral adherence and muscle-protecting physiology interlock.

interaction_mechanism.description: Mechanism; state whether tested factorially or inferred from separate studies.

evidence_conflicts.description: All mandatory conflict topics from the input plus any others found.

conflicting_findings.description: The competing positions with their key data (design, N, effect in natural units).

key_limitations.description: 8-15 methodological limitations of the evidence base, one dense sentence each with a concrete example.

references.description: Every source cited anywhere, each cited at least once.

id.description: FirstAuthorYear, suffix a/b for duplicates, e.g. Helms2014a.

citation.description: First 3 authors et al., title, journal, year, volume(issue):pages.

population_and_sample.description: Population, N (and k for meta-analyses), duration.

url.description: https://doi.org/<DOI> preferred; otherwise PubMed or PMC URL.

verified.description: true only if the page was retrieved and title, authors, year and reported numbers were confirmed.
